description: This dataset records biological measurements of Mytilus balthica mussels collected during the EMB320 expedition in the Rönnebank region of the Baltic Sea during June 2023. It compares data from reference areas and marine protected sites, capturing shell lengths and their corresponding frequencies. The data includes integer values for shell size and count, allowing researchers to analyze population structures and size distributions. This resource is valuable for marine biologists studying the impact of conservation measures on mussel communities, enabling comparisons between protected and non-protected zones to assess ecological health and biodiversity trends in the Baltic Sea.
